row.notes: Robin-hood lookup of *key in entryMap (hash mul +0x10, 0x24-byte entries at +0x18, end +0x20); if found calls visitor+0x38 vfunc +0x10 with entry+4. Then looks *key up in owner map at +0x6f0 (0x28-byte entries) and for every u32 id in that entry's vector (+0x10..+0x18) repeats the entryMap lookup and callback; traps if the second lookup misses. Context from caller: HudCustomisation leave screen / copy UI data, so entries are HUD element layout records and the owner map is a group-to-children table.
